extDescription.message: Track the points you earn on MakerWorld by day, month and model, split into designs and boosts. Unofficial extension.

noModelPoints.message: No model earnings in this period

modelTip.message: $1: $2 from design and profiles · $3 from boosts ($4)

note.message: Main numbers are exclusive points; regular points are shown in grey. Dollars at US$$ $1 per exclusive point. Redemptions (grey) and penalties (red) are shown separately and don't subtract from earnings.

step2.message: If MakerWorld isn't open, the extension opens it in a background tab for a few seconds to read your points.

step3.message: Click Sync. The first time it loads your whole history and may take a moment.

startFoot.message: After that it syncs when you open the extension and every 3 hours while a MakerWorld tab is open.

helpExclusive.message: Exclusive: the main points your models earn. These are the big numbers.

helpRegular.message: Regular: MakerWorld's other kind of points. Shown in grey and not added to exclusive points.

helpUsd.message: Dollars: an estimate at US$$ $1 per exclusive point (change it in Settings).

helpDesign.message: Designs: rewards for your models and their print profiles.

helpBoost.message: Boosts: points you get when someone boosts one of your models.

helpOther.message: Other: courses, profile tasks and other entries.

helpRedeem.message: Redemptions: points you exchanged for cash or products. Shown separately, in grey; they don't subtract from earnings.

helpCards.message: On makerworld.com, your models show in green the exclusive points they have earned.

errNoTab.message: No MakerWorld tab is open. Open it, sign in and sync again.

errAuth.message: MakerWorld rejected the request. Sign in to makerworld.com and sync again.

errNoPoints.message: Couldn't read your points. Go to makerworld.com/points while signed in and sync again.

errReload.message: Couldn't reach the MakerWorld tab. Reload it and sync again.

welcomeIntro.message: Follow, day by day, the points your models earn on MakerWorld: how much comes from your designs, how much from boosts, and what it's worth in dollars.

wStep1Body.message: Open makerworld.com and sign in to your account. The extension reads your points with that session: it never sees or stores your password.

wStep2Body.message: Click Chrome's puzzle-piece icon at the top right and pin Points Tracker so it's always at hand.

wStep3Body.message: Open the extension and click Sync, or do it from here. The first time it loads your whole history. If MakerWorld isn't open, the extension opens it in a background tab for a few seconds and closes it.

wSyncOk.message: Done: $1 new entries. Open the extension to see your points.

privacyBody.message: Everything stays in your browser. The extension has no server and sends your data nowhere: it only queries makerworld.com from your own tab.

disclaimer.message: Unofficial extension. Not affiliated with MakerWorld or Bambu Lab.

diagHint.message: This page shows what the extension learned from MakerWorld's real traffic. If the boost/design classification is off, look at the label field of the raw records: that's the text it decides on.

nothingCaptured.message: Nothing captured yet. Browse your points history on MakerWorld.

checkHint.message: Sum of the whole history compared with the balance MakerWorld reports. If they match, exclusive and regular points are being split correctly.

errApiChanged.message: MakerWorld changed how it delivers your points and this version can't read it. Look for an extension update.

usdRateHint.message: Used to convert points to dollars. If MakerWorld changes its redemption value, update it here.

autoOpenLabel.message: Sync every 3 hours even if MakerWorld isn't open

autoOpenHint.message: Opens MakerWorld in a background tab for a few seconds and closes it.

backupHint.message: Uninstalling the extension deletes your data. Export a backup to restore it later.

importBad.message: That file is not a valid Points Tracker backup.

balanceMismatch.message: Your history adds up to $1, but your MakerWorld balance is $2. Some entries may be missing.

apiChangedNotice.message: The last sync failed because MakerWorld changed something. Numbers may be out of date.

helpPenalty.message: Penalties: points MakerWorld took away, for example for breaking a model's exclusivity. Shown separately, in red; they don't subtract from earnings.
